title: Independently computed query candidate-universe row v1

candidate_document_count.description: Number of filter-admissible command documents; this is not a relevance or fact-eligibility count.

candidate_document_ids_sha256.description: Digest of the canonical, deterministically sorted post-filter command_id set.

source_pointer_membership_sha256.description: Digest of the complete canonical command-to-source-pointer membership for the candidate set.

$comment: Admission requires expected_top_k_cardinality = min(20, candidate_document_count), one row per active query, query receipt digest agreement, one identical immutable command-index-manifest reference across the suite, and recomputation of both membership digests under computation_policy.
